title: Strict margins support finite certificates without supplying a separation
statement: Approximate an optimal closed allocation by ordinary rays, mix a small positive reference allocation and fill the positive covariance residual; inverse-cost continuity on the resulting positive capacity gives ordinary costs tending to beta from above. Thus every strict positive fieldwise margin is certifiable by an ordinary finite quadrature at slightly smaller margin and supplied17 compression. For rational field moments and a strict negative alternative, add a small positive quadratic term while keeping negative energy, approximate cubic coefficients within V and quadratic coefficients modulo determinant rationally, and retain a strict completed ROC Schur margin. Four bounded rational charts admit sufficiently fine tensor Bernstein positive-coefficient subdivision of the retained(6,6) biform. This proves a possible finite certificate search under a strict gap; no new negative globally ROC polynomial or universal compatibility result was obtained.
